bottle.description: A rigid or semi-rigid container with a narrow neck used to hold and dispense liquids.
bottle.purpose: Used to store, transport, and dispense drinking water, beverages, and other liquids.
common_uses: Carrying drinking water and hydration beverages
Storing cooking oils, sauces, or condiments
Packaging household and personal care liquids
care_notes: Rinse and wash regularly with warm soapy water or as recommended by the manufacturer.
Allow to air dry completely to avoid bacterial or mold growth.
safety_notes: Do not pour boiling liquids into single-use plastics or containers not rated for heat.
Check that reusable bottles are BPA-free and food-safe.
limitations: The detector identifies the broad bottle category and cannot determine contents, liquid safety, or exact material reliably from the image alone.

cup.description: An open-top container typically used for holding and drinking hot or cold beverages.
cup.purpose: Designed for immediate consumption of drinking liquids.
common_uses: Drinking water, coffee, tea, milk, or juices
Measuring ingredients in cooking
Holding pens or small desk supplies
components: Handle (often present on mugs and tea cups)
care_notes: Wash after every use with dish soap and warm water.
Check microwave and dishwasher suitability markings on ceramic, glass, or plastic cups.
safety_notes: Handle hot beverages with care to prevent scalds and burns.
Inspect ceramic and glassware for chips or cracks that could cause injury.
limitations: The detector cannot distinguish ceramic, paper, or plastic composition, nor whether the cup currently contains liquid.

cell phone.description: A portable electronic telecommunication device with touchscreen display, camera, and compute capabilities.
cell phone.purpose: Facilitates communication, internet access, productivity, navigation, and digital photography.
common_uses: Voice and video calling, messaging, and email
Web browsing and running mobile applications
Photography, audio recording, and media consumption
Navigation and GPS location services
care_notes: Clean screen with a microfiber cloth; avoid harsh chemicals.
Protect from drops and impacts with a protective case and screen protector.
Avoid exposing the device to extreme temperatures or prolonged moisture.
safety_notes: Use certified chargers and cables to avoid overheating and battery damage.
Do not use or charge if the battery shows signs of swelling or puncturing.
limitations: The detector recognizes the form factor of a phone but cannot determine make, model, operating state, or lock status.

laptop.description: A portable personal computer integrating a screen, keyboard, trackpad, and internal compute hardware.
laptop.purpose: Used for personal, academic, and professional computing tasks on the go.
common_uses: Software development, writing, and administrative work
Web browsing, research, and communication
Media playback, video meetings, and gaming
components: Internal motherboard, CPU, GPU, and RAM
External I/O ports and cooling vents
care_notes: Keep cooling vents clear of dust and soft surfaces like blankets.
Clean keyboard and screen with designated electronics cleaner and lint-free cloths.
Power down or put to sleep before carrying in a backpack.
safety_notes: Keep liquids away from the keyboard and ports to avoid short circuits.
Allow adequate ventilation during heavy processing to avoid thermal throttling and overheating.
limitations: The detector recognizes the laptop form factor but cannot determine specifications, battery health, or operating system.

mouse.description: A handheld pointing device that detects two-dimensional motion relative to a supporting surface.
mouse.purpose: Allows users to control the cursor and interact with graphic elements on a computer screen.
common_uses: Navigating software interfaces and operating systems
Selecting, clicking, dragging, and scrolling content
Precision input for design, editing, and gaming
care_notes: Clean the bottom glide pads and optical sensor lens with a dry cotton swab.
Wipe down shell with mild disinfectant wipes.
safety_notes: Practice ergonomic wrist alignment to avoid repetitive strain injuries.
limitations: The detector cannot assess whether the mouse is wired or wireless, connected, or powered on.

keyboard.description: An input peripheral device with an arrangement of buttons or keys representing alphanumeric characters and functions.
keyboard.purpose: Used to enter text, commands, and shortcuts into a computer or digital terminal.
common_uses: Typing documents, emails, and code
Navigating operating systems via hotkeys and shortcuts
Gaming controls and accessibility input
components: Key switches (membrane, mechanical, or scissor switch)
Base chassis and printed circuit board
care_notes: Use compressed air to dislodge crumbs and dust between keycaps.
Avoid eating or drinking directly over the keyboard.
safety_notes: Unplug before any deep cleaning or switch replacement.
Maintain a comfortable typing posture to reduce wrist fatigue.
limitations: The detector cannot inspect key switch type, layout standard (QWERTY/AZERTY), or connection status.

book.description: A set of written, printed, or blank sheets bound together within covers.
book.purpose: Records, preserves, and presents text and images for reading, study, or entertainment.
common_uses: Reading literature, non-fiction, textbooks, and reference material
Note-taking and journaling (notebooks)
Visual appreciation (artbooks and photo albums)
care_notes: Store upright on shelves in a cool, dry area away from direct sunlight.
Avoid humid conditions that can foster mold or page warping.
safety_notes: Paper edges can cause minor paper cuts.
Keep dry and away from open flames.
limitations: The detector identifies the general book shape but cannot read title, author, or language from afar.

backpack.description: A fabric sack worn on the back with two shoulder straps.
backpack.purpose: Used for carrying personal belongings, books, gear, and supplies hands-free.
common_uses: Carrying school books, laptops, and stationery
Commuting, travel, and day trips
Hiking, trekking, and carrying outdoor equipment
care_notes: Spot clean with mild detergent and water; air dry thoroughly.
Do not overload beyond rated weight to preserve stitching and zippers.
safety_notes: Wear with both shoulder straps to distribute load evenly and avoid spinal strain.
Ensure heavy items are packed close to the back panel.
limitations: The detector cannot assess internal contents or weight capacity.

chair.description: A piece of furniture designed for one person to sit on.
chair.purpose: Provides seated body support for rest, work, dining, or socializing.
common_uses: Office and desk seating
Dining table seating
Relaxing in lounges, waiting rooms, or outdoors
components: Legs or central pedestal with casters
care_notes: Check and tighten assembly bolts periodically on swivel and office chairs.
Vacuum fabric upholstery or wipe clean leather/plastic surfaces.
safety_notes: Do not stand on wheeled chairs or use as a step stool.
Adhere to manufacturer weight limits.
limitations: The detector cannot evaluate structural integrity or weight rating.

remote.description: A handheld electronic device used to control another device wirelessly from a short distance.
remote.purpose: Transmits command signals (infrared or Bluetooth) to televisions, audio gear, or appliances.
common_uses: Changing television channels, volume, and input sources
Controlling air conditioner settings and streaming players
Navigating media playback and menus
components: Infrared (IR) emitter LED or Bluetooth transmitter
care_notes: Wipe down buttons with a disinfectant wipe, avoiding excessive liquid.
Replace old batteries promptly to prevent corrosive leakage.
safety_notes: Keep button cell batteries out of reach of small children and pets.
limitations: The detector cannot determine which specific appliance or TV model the remote pairs with.

scissors.description: A hand-operated cutting instrument consisting of two metal blades pivoted together.
scissors.purpose: Used for cutting thin materials such as paper, cardboard, cloth, rope, or food.
common_uses: Cutting craft paper, tape, and office documents
Sewing, tailoring, and fabric cutting
Kitchen food preparation (culinary shears)
Hairdressing and grooming
care_notes: Wipe blades clean and dry after use to prevent rust.
Sharpen periodically with appropriate blade sharpeners.
safety_notes: Always cut away from body and fingers.
Carry with blades pointed downward and handle forward when passing to someone else.
Keep out of reach of young children without adult supervision.
limitations: The detector cannot judge blade sharpness or specific craft vs. kitchen shear grading.

clock.description: An instrument designed for measuring, verifying, and displaying the passage of time.
clock.purpose: Provides visual or auditory timekeeping for schedule coordination and daily activities.
common_uses: Checking the current hour, minute, and second
Setting alarms for waking up or task reminders
Decorative interior wall or desk display
components: Hour, minute, and second hands (analog) or LED/LCD digits
Frame or housing and power source (battery/mains)
care_notes: Dust clock face regularly with a microfiber cloth.
Replace alkaline batteries annually to prevent leakage.
safety_notes: Mount wall clocks securely on wall anchors to prevent falling.
limitations: The detector cannot tell whether the clock is currently ticking or displaying accurate time.

umbrella.description: A folding canopy supported by wooden or metal ribs, mounted on a central stick.
umbrella.purpose: Shields the user from rain, snow, or harsh sunlight.
common_uses: Walking in rainy weather to stay dry
Sunshade protection on bright, hot days
Patio and beach sun shielding
care_notes: Leave umbrella open to dry completely before collapsing to avoid mildew and rust.
Keep ribs untangled when folding.
safety_notes: Be mindful of pointed rib tips in crowded pedestrian areas.
Avoid opening against severe gale-force winds to prevent inversion.
limitations: The detector recognizes umbrellas in open or closed form, but cannot test canopy waterproofing.

handbag.description: A medium-to-large handled bag used primarily for carrying personal items.
handbag.purpose: Provides convenient portable storage for wallet, keys, phone, and daily essentials.
common_uses: Daily personal organization and commuting
Carrying currency, cosmetics, identification, and sunglasses
Fashion accessory complementing personal attire
care_notes: Clean leather or fabric exterior with appropriate material conditioner or damp cloth.
Store stuffed with tissue paper to preserve structural shape when not in use.
safety_notes: Keep zipped or clasped in public crowded areas to prevent pickpocketing.
limitations: The detector cannot determine brand authenticity or internal pocket contents.

fork.description: An eating and serving utensil consisting of a handle with several narrow tines at one end.
fork.purpose: Used to pierce, hold, or lift food items while dining or preparing meals.
common_uses: Eating solid foods such as vegetables, pasta, and meat
Holding food in place while cutting with a knife
Whisking eggs or mashing soft foods like potatoes
care_notes: Wash with dishwashing liquid and warm water or dishwasher.
Dry thoroughly to prevent water spots on stainless steel.
safety_notes: Prongs can be sharp; handle carefully around children.
limitations: The detector cannot assess food cleanliness or metal grade.

knife.description: An edge tool or utensil with a sharpened blade attached to a handle.
knife.purpose: Used for cutting, slicing, chopping, and preparing food or utility materials.
common_uses: Slicing vegetables, fruits, bread, and meat
Spreading butter or spreads (table knife)
Utility cutting of packaging and materials
care_notes: Hand wash kitchen knives immediately after use and dry promptly.
Hone and sharpen blades regularly with a whetstone or honing steel.
safety_notes: Always cut away from hands on a secure, stable cutting board.
Never attempt to catch a falling knife; step back and let it drop.
Store in a knife block, magnetic strip, or blade sheath out of children's reach.
limitations: The detector cannot distinguish culinary knives from table knives or evaluate edge sharpness.

spoon.description: An eating and cooking utensil consisting of a small shallow bowl on a handle.
spoon.purpose: Used primarily for scooping, serving, stirring, and eating liquids or semi-solid foods.
common_uses: Eating soups, stews, cereals, yogurt, and ice cream
Stirring hot drinks such as tea and coffee
Measuring cooking ingredients
care_notes: Dishwasher safe for stainless steel; hand wash wooden spoons promptly.
Do not soak wooden spoons in standing water.
safety_notes: Check temperature before tasting hot soups or drinks to avoid mouth burns.
limitations: The detector cannot verify spoon volume (tablespoon vs. teaspoon) or material grade.

bowl.description: A round, deep dish or container used for preparing, holding, or serving food.
bowl.purpose: Holds liquids, salads, grains, and mixed ingredients without spilling.
common_uses: Serving soup, cereal, noodles, and salad
Mixing batters, doughs, and marinades during cooking
Serving snacks and fruit
care_notes: Wash with dish detergent and warm water.
Check microwave-safe labeling before heating ceramics or glassware.
safety_notes: Ceramic and glass bowls become very hot when microwaved; use oven mitts.
Discard chipped bowls to prevent ceramic shards and bacterial retention.
limitations: The detector cannot determine if the bowl contains food or hot liquid.

banana.description: An elongated, curved edible fruit produced by large herbaceous flowering plants.
banana.purpose: Consumed as a nutritious, energy-dense fresh fruit or cooking ingredient.
common_uses: Direct snacking after peeling
Smoothies, baking (banana bread), desserts, and breakfast bowls
care_notes: Store at room temperature away from direct sunlight; refrigerating ripens skin quickly.
safety_notes: Banana peels on floors create slipping hazards.
limitations: The detector cannot assess exact sweetness, ripeness, or inner bruising.

apple.description: A round, edible pomaceous fruit produced by an apple tree.
apple.purpose: Consumed fresh or processed into juice, cider, applesauce, and baked dishes.
common_uses: Fresh snacking
Salads, baking pies and tarts, making jams and sauces
Juicing and pressing cider
care_notes: Store in a refrigerator crisper drawer to maintain freshness and crispness.
Wash thoroughly under running water before consumption.
safety_notes: Apple seeds contain traces of amygdalin; avoid ingesting large quantities of chewed seeds.
limitations: The detector cannot identify the exact apple cultivar (e.g., Honeycrisp vs. Gala) from visual form alone.

potted plant.description: A living plant grown in a container or flowerpot rather than directly in the ground.
potted plant.purpose: Provides aesthetic indoor decoration, air freshening, and horticultural enjoyment.
common_uses: Home and office interior decoration
Air quality enhancement and biophilic ambiance
Herbal cooking (fresh culinary herbs like basil, mint)
care_notes: Water according to specific plant species requirements; avoid overwatering.
Ensure adequate light exposure (direct, indirect, or low light).
safety_notes: Check toxicity for domestic pets (cats and dogs), as many common houseplants (e.g., lilies, philodendrons) are toxic if ingested.
limitations: The detector identifies the general potted plant category and cannot identify botanical species or soil moisture.

watch.description: A portable timepiece intended to be carried or worn by a person on the wrist.
watch.purpose: Provides convenient and immediate timekeeping, date tracking, and fashion accessorizing.
common_uses: Checking the current time and date
Tracking elapsed time with stopwatches or chronographs
Personal accessory and everyday style
components: Dial face and hands or digital display
Movement mechanism (quartz, automatic, or smartwatch digital module)
care_notes: Wipe clean with a soft microfiber cloth to remove dust and sweat.
Check water resistance rating before submerging or showering.
Replace battery or charge periodically.
safety_notes: Avoid wearing loose straps near rotating machinery or power tools.
limitations: The detector cannot assess whether the watch is mechanical or digital, nor its current battery charge or time accuracy.

wristwatch.description: A portable timepiece designed to be worn on the wrist.
wristwatch.purpose: Enables quick timekeeping and calendar tracking throughout the day.
common_uses: Checking time and elapsed intervals
Personal accessory and fashion statement
components: Dial and hands or digital screen
care_notes: Clean regularly with a dry lint-free cloth.
Keep away from strong magnetic fields if mechanical.
safety_notes: Remove during heavy manual labor to prevent snagging.
limitations: The detector recognizes the form factor but cannot authenticate brand or model.

glasses.description: Frames bearing lenses worn in front of the eyes for vision correction or eye protection.
glasses.purpose: Corrects refractive errors (nearsightedness, farsightedness, astigmatism) or protects eyes from UV light.
common_uses: Reading, driving, computer screen work
UV and sunlight protection (sunglasses)
Eye safety in workshops or sports
care_notes: Clean lenses using a dedicated microfiber cloth and lens cleaner spray; avoid rough paper towels.
Store in a rigid protective case when not in use.
safety_notes: Do not use cracked or chipped glass lenses near eyes.
limitations: The detector cannot measure prescription strength, lens coating type, or optical magnification.

eyeglasses.description: A pair of corrective lenses held in a frame against the bridge of the nose and ears.
eyeglasses.purpose: Improves visual acuity for near, intermediate, or distance vision.
common_uses: Daily vision enhancement
Reading and screen viewing
care_notes: Rinse with lukewarm water and wipe dry with a clean microfiber cloth.
safety_notes: Keep away from direct heat sources to prevent frame warping.
limitations: Optical prescription cannot be determined visually.

headphones.description: A pair of small loudspeaker drivers worn on or around the head over a user's ears.
headphones.purpose: Converts audio signals into private audible sound for music, calls, and monitoring.
common_uses: Listening to music, podcasts, or lectures privately
Voice and video conferencing calls
Active noise cancellation in loud environments
care_notes: Wipe ear cushions with an alcohol-free damp cloth.
Avoid excessive cable bending or twisting.
Store in a dry protective pouch or headphone stand.
safety_notes: Keep listening volumes below recommended thresholds (under 85 dB) to prevent permanent hearing damage.
limitations: The detector cannot inspect driver health, wireless connection, or battery state.

pen.description: A handheld writing instrument used to apply ink to a surface, usually paper.
pen.purpose: Used for handwriting, drawing, sketching, signing documents, and note-taking.
common_uses: Writing notes, essays, and journals
Signing legal or financial documents
Artistic drawing, sketching, and calligraphy
components: Writing tip (ballpoint, rollerball, fountain nib, or gel point)
care_notes: Always cap or retract the tip when not writing to prevent ink drying out.
Store horizontally or tip-down depending on ink type.
safety_notes: Keep out of reach of very young children to avoid choking on small caps.
limitations: The detector cannot ascertain ink color, remaining ink volume, or point size.

pencil.description: An implement for writing or drawing consisting of a thin graphite core enclosed in a wooden or plastic casing.
pencil.purpose: Used for writing, technical drafting, shading, and sketching that can be erased.
common_uses: Schoolwork, drafting, drawing, and sketching
Writing temporary notes that can be modified or corrected
care_notes: Sharpen carefully to avoid breaking the internal lead core.
Keep dry to prevent wood warping.
safety_notes: Sharpened tips can pierce skin if handled carelessly.
limitations: The detector cannot distinguish lead hardness (HB, 2B, etc.) from distance.

keys.description: A cut metal device or electronic key fob used to operate a mechanical or electronic lock.
keys.purpose: Provides security and access control for doors, vehicles, cabinets, and locks.
common_uses: Unlocking residential, office, or vehicle entryways
Operating vehicle ignitions or padlocks
components: Key blade with cuts and bittings
care_notes: Keep free from excessive grime and avoid bending or forcing in jammed locks.
safety_notes: Do not leave keys visible in unsecured public areas to prevent unauthorized duplication.
limitations: The detector identifies the key silhouette but cannot determine lock compatibility.

wallet.description: A small flat folding case used to hold paper currency, bank cards, and personal identification.
wallet.purpose: Provides organized portable storage for financial cards, cash, and identification documents.
common_uses: Carrying currency, debit and credit cards, and driver's licenses
Holding transit cards and business cards
components: Coin pouch or ID window (on select styles)
care_notes: Condition leather periodically; avoid overstuffing to preserve stitching.
safety_notes: Keep in a secure, concealed pocket in crowded transit zones to guard against theft.
limitations: The detector cannot inspect card contents, cash value, or RFID blocking.

charger.description: An electrical power adapter and cable assembly used to replenish rechargeable battery devices.
charger.purpose: Converts AC mains electrical power into regulated DC power for electronic gadgets.
common_uses: Charging smartphones, laptops, tablets, and wearable electronics
Powering peripherals and desktop accessories
care_notes: Avoid sharply bending cables near connector boots.
Unplug by gripping the connector head rather than pulling the wire.
safety_notes: Use certified adapters to prevent electrical hazards and overheating.
Do not use cables with exposed wires or frayed jackets.
limitations: The detector cannot determine wattage rating, voltage output, or cable health.

calculator.description: An electronic or mechanical calculating device used to perform mathematical arithmetic and scientific calculations.
calculator.purpose: Facilitates rapid numerical computation for academic, financial, and engineering tasks.
common_uses: Solving arithmetic, algebraic, or trigonometric equations
Financial accounting and tax calculations
Classroom and engineering problem solving
components: Internal circuit processor and solar/battery power cell
care_notes: Keep display screen clean with a dry microfiber cloth.
Store away from moisture and direct heat.
safety_notes: Replace coin-cell batteries with care; keep small batteries away from infants.
limitations: The detector identifies the calculator form factor but cannot determine specific computational modes or memory contents.
